OpenAI SDK pointed at OpenRouter (NVIDIA Nemotron free model)

implemented_capabilities.capability: Eligible-bidder matching with hard filters, cooldown, direct capability coverage and 5-hop lookalike-peer traversal
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real OpenCypher against FalkorDB: filters on blacklist, GST validity per region, turnover/net worth/solvency/staff, 2-day alert cooldown on MATCHED_TENDER, certification/brand-authorisation/enlistment validity via valid_until > $now, plus a lookalike path Client->shared capability<-Peer-[BID_HISTORY WON]->past Tender<-Department->Tender. The final score is a hand-set heuristic (0.55 base + 0.25*spec_ratio + 0.10/0.20 lookalike boost + affinity), not a learned or calibrated model.
Large (~320 line) function pairing lead and partner clients with complementary coverage; PARTNERSHIP_AFFINITY update on outcome sets hard-coded scores (0.98 on WON, 0.65 on LOST).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Outcome feedback learning loop (idempotent, correctable) updating DEPARTMENT_AFFINITY / CATEGORY_AFFINITY
implemented_capabilities.notes: Duplicate outcomes are ignored (prev_status check); WON<->LOST corrections apply +/-1 deltas; Laplace-smoothed affinity_weight = ((wins+1)/(total+2)-0.5)*0.5 clipped at zero counts. Memory is just relationship properties in the graph.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Alert dispatch with Cypher-enforced cooldown and AgentDecision audit nodes
implemented_capabilities.notes: Linear 4-node LangGraph (triage_procurement -> graph_matching -> cognitive_reasoning -> dispatch_alerts) that calls MCP tools; 'dispatch' writes MATCHED_TENDER/AgentDecision nodes in the graph, no outbound email transport was found in the code (smtplib grep empty).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dual-LLM reasoning over matches (Agent Alpha / Beta via OpenRouter Nemotron free model)
implemented_capabilities.notes: The 'two agents' are two API keys calling the same free model with different prompts to narrate already-computed Cypher results; the ranking itself is deterministic Cypher+Python. Reasoning text is LLM prose over graph facts.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Tender scraping, LLM/heuristic enrichment and graph ingestion
implemented_capabilities.notes: Scrapers fetch GeM/CPPP/CPWD listing pages (robots.txt check present in base.py); tender_enrich fills missing financial/BOQ/brand/product requirement fields from seed JSON tables (tender_enrich/seed/*.json), i.e. synthetic enrichment, not source data. Client roster in db/seed_graph.py is 12 invented contractors.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph schema bootstrap (indexes) and demo seeding
implemented_capabilities.notes: Idempotent CREATE INDEX FOR (n:Label) ON (n.prop) over 15 label/prop pairs; seed_database can graph.delete() the target graph (clear_existing=True default).

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels: Ministry, Department, Tender, Client, WorkCategory, Specialization, Certification, Brand, Product, EnlistmentClass, Region, AgentDecision, SystemMeta, JVConsortium. Edges: ISSUED, HAS_DEPARTMENT, LOCATED_IN, IN_CATEGORY, REQUIRES_SPECIALIZATION/REQUIRES_CERT/PREFERS_BRAND/REQUIRES_PRODUCT/REQUIRES_ENLISTMENT, OPERATES_IN{gst_valid}, WORKS_IN, HAS_SPECIALIZATION, HOLDS_CERT{valid_until}, AUTHORIZED_FOR{territory,valid_until}, SUPPLIES{is_oem}, ENLISTED_AS|HOLDS_ENLISTMENT, MATCHED_TENDER{status,last_alert_sent,alert_count}, BID_HISTORY{outcome}, DEPARTMENT_AFFINITY/CATEGORY_AFFINITY{wins,losses,win_rate,affinity_weight}, PARTNERSHIP_AFFINITY, FORMED_FOR_TENDER, FOR_CLIENT, EVALUATED_TENDER. Cypher uses $params throughout for matching/learning queries, pattern comprehensions ([(t)-[:X]->(n) | n.name]), OPTIONAL MATCH + collect(DISTINCT), multi-type relationship alternation, MERGE + SET counters. No APOC/GDS. Uses graph.query for everything (not ro_query), including the 'read-only' diagnostic tools. Seed code interpolates ids into trace strings only (not into Cypher).
algorithms: Hard-eligibility Cypher filter with time-bounded validity (valid_until > $now) and alert cooldown (172800s) in mcp_server/server.py:discover_direct_and_lookalike_matches
Direct capability coverage ratio and heuristic composite score (0.55 base + 0.25*spec ratio + lookalike boost + learned affinity) in the same function
5-hop lookalike peer traversal through shared capability nodes and department win history
Laplace-smoothed win-rate affinity with idempotent correction deltas in mcp_server/server.py:record_bid_outcome_and_learn
Linear LangGraph pipeline orchestration in agent/langgraph_workflow.py:build_graph
backend_interfaces: FastMCP stdio server mcp_server/server.py with ~20 tools (get_active_tenders_and_sync_status, discover_direct_and_lookalike_matches, discover_jv_consortium_matches, dispatch_tender_alert_with_trace, record_bid_outcome_and_learn, execute_read_cypher, execute_cypher_traversal, get_alerts_and_agent_memory, record_jv_outcome_and_learn, get_graph_visualization_snapshot, enrich_and_ingest_tender, scrape_and_ingest_live_tenders, delete_all_active_tenders_mcp, reset_and_seed_demo_graph, get_tender_requirements, check_client_coverage, get_department_lineage, find_peer_clients, explore_paths, get_client_and_tender_for_email)
tenderscrape CLI (python -m tenderscrape) and tender_enrich CLI, pipeline/cron_runner.py
FastAPI app api/main.py is imported by tests but the api/ directory is NOT present in this checkout, so the HTTP layer cannot be audited
frontend_interfaces: none present (no UI files in the checkout)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: MCP client agent (BidGraphMCPAgent) launching the MCP server as a stdio subprocess, plus a linear LangGraph state machine. Graph-resident memory: AgentDecision nodes (with outcome_feedback), MATCHED_TENDER alert state, and win/loss affinity edges updated by record_bid_outcome_and_learn. LLM is used only to narrate reasoning.
tests_present: tests/ has 3 files with ~17 test functions (phase1 MCP+graph, phase2 agent+API incl. an AST test forbidding falkordb imports in agent/ and api/, phase4 JV+LangGraph). Phase 2/4 tests import api.main which is missing from the checkout, so they would fail as shipped. Tests need a live FalkorDB. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: mcp_server/server.py:1094-1100 - execute_read_cypher 'read-only' guard is a space-delimited substring denylist (CREATE/MERGE/SET/DELETE/REMOVE/DROP) and then runs graph.query (a write-capable call), so it is bypassable (e.g. 'CREATE(' or newline/tab delimited keywords, CALL procedures, GRAPH.DELETE-style via procedures). Should use ro_query.

mcp_server/server.py:1516-1535 - execute_cypher_traversal guard splits on whitespace and compares uppercase words; a token like 'SET' glued to punctuation (e.g. 'DELETE(n)', 'n)SET') evades it; executes via graph.query. LLM-supplied Cypher is run verbatim.
mcp_server/server.py:1484-1515 - delete_all_active_tenders_mcp and reset_and_seed_demo_graph are exposed as MCP tools and can wipe the graph (seed_database(clear_existing=True) calls graph.delete()).
db/connection.py:~40-48 - FALKORDB_SSL path sets ssl_cert_reqs=None and ssl_check_hostname=False, disabling TLS verification.
agent/mcp_agent.py:71-110 - OpenRouter API keys read from env/settings; no hard-coded key found (grep for sk-/nvapi-/AIza/hf_ patterns returned nothing in .py/.json/.md files).

tenderscrape/base.py:14,53-123 - outbound httpx scraping of third-party government portals (robots.txt check implemented); data/raw/ commits ~40 raw scraped HTML pages from GeM/CPPP/CPWD, whose re-use terms are not stated in the repo.
mcp_server/server.py:387-401 - trace strings interpolate ids/names into text (not Cypher); low risk.
No eval/exec/pickle/shell=True in non-test code. Only subprocess use is the MCP server launch via StdioServerParameters (agent/mcp_agent.py:190).
duplicates_or_overlaps: Procurement / bidder-to-tender matching with learned affinities; generic overlap with recommendation or lead-matching engines and with other 'agent memory in the graph' hackathon entries (outcome-feedback weights on edges). Not a blast-radius, RCA or provenance engine.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - valid_until-gated credentials, cooldown state and idempotent WON/LOST correction deltas show a little temporal validity and reversal handling, but there is no provenance chain, supersession model or dependency invalidation of derived conclusions.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: The outcome-feedback pattern (idempotent status transition, +/-1 correction deltas, Laplace-smoothed affinity edges, cooldown enforced in Cypher) is a compact reference for graph-resident agent memory, and the time-validity-filtered capability match query is a reusable Cypher idiom. Everything is tightly bound to the Indian tender schema and to a single 1900-line module.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB; OpenRouter key only for the narration step

strategy_rationale: Domain-specific tender matching with heuristic scores, an unsafe pseudo-read-only Cypher tool and a missing api/ package; worth mining for the affinity-learning and validity-filter Cypher idioms but not for direct merge.
